title: Register auth router and apply auth dependency in chatbot/api/app.py
description:
Modify chatbot/api/app.py to register the auth_router from chatbot/api/auth.py and apply the get_current_user dependency as a global or per-router dependency where appropriate. Companion endpoints may also need registration.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- docs/operations.md
- docs/architecture.md
- docs/PLANS/ACTIVE/CHATBOT/README.md
- docs/PLANS/ACTIVE/CHATBOT/DISPATCH.md
- chatbot/api/app.py (existing FastAPI app with router registrations — understand the app variable name, include_router pattern, and any existing dependencies)
- chatbot/api/auth.py (created by task c.7 — auth_router, endpoint paths)
- chatbot/auth/dependencies.py (created by task c.5 — get_current_user signature)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY chatbot/api/app.py. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed path. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed file modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.

Implementation details:

1. Open chatbot/api/app.py and understand:
   - The FastAPI app variable name.
   - How routers are imported and registered (app.include_router(...)).
   - Whether dependencies are applied at app level, router level, or per-endpoint.
   - Existing imports and module structure.

2. Import auth_router from chatbot.api.auth.

3. Register auth_router: `app.include_router(auth_router)`. The auth_router already has prefix '/auth' — do not double-prefix.

4. Do NOT apply get_current_user as a global dependency on the entire app — auth endpoints (signup, login) must be publicly accessible. Any global auth dependency would break those.

5. Leave existing router registrations unchanged.

6. Do NOT create a new FastAPI instance or add middleware.
acceptance_criteria: Existing router registrations in app.py are unchanged
No global authentication dependency is applied (auth endpoints remain open)
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: add CORS, middleware, or global authentication dependency
change the Abracapocus runtime, orchestrator, or backends

allowed: add an import statement for auth_router
follow existing import and registration conventions
forbidden: add any new features or endpoints directly in app.py
